direct_cause: Fixture envelope passed as record; partial/absent journeys; missing probes and scalar aggregation. Review also found decoded-content incorrectly budgeted as first feedback and readiness eligibility/document-level Shift incorrectly budgeted as completed target interaction.
class_root: No shared boundary validated action identity, browser milestones, raw distributions, coverage lifecycle and report acceptance independently.
affected_population: Every workflow action, cache/scale combination and future report consumer
Linux/native-display/CI runs, reload and missing probe, empty/planned/partial samples

internal_only_reason: This is an internal test/evidence contract; no third-party runtime behavior is changed. Existing Electron43.4.1, Playwright and launch/network guard remain pinned.
invariants: Trusted input, first attributable project feedback, decoded content, production eligibility and completed target-control response belong to one document/probe and clock; content and target response may occur in either order

First-feedback budgets use feedbackAt; interactive budgets use a visible matching production menu after its trusted input, never data-ready or a document key listener; loading frame distributions do not certify active-gesture budgets

generality_proof: Producer and consumer both use the same normalized sample, raw aggregation and acceptance facts. Missing/replaced document, invalid CLI and empty/legacy/unsupported pass claims fail closed for every scale/cache. Full journeys remain nonexecutable planned rows.

prevention.failure_mode: Nonzero acceptance status and explicit planned/blocked_environment/invalid/inconclusive evidence; historic raw retained.
prevention.strategy: Normalize and validate before aggregation; independently revalidate report samples and refuse acceptance for actions whose full metric contract is not implemented.

legacy_paths.rationale: Removed partial P1/P2/C branches, fixture-only execution placeholders,250ms delay/elapsedMs, silent probe fallback and scalar quantile aggregation. Same files now expose only the atomic action and contract; historical raw stays unmodified.
